title: Connector configuration
description: A declared data-source connection. The declaration is committed; the credential never is. Every property that could carry a secret is an external reference name, and no property capable of holding a literal credential exists in this schema, so an inline secret is inexpressible rather than merely invalid (FR-30, SEC-013).

name.description: Names this connector. Environment bindings reference it by this name.

kind.description: The class of data source. An enumeration rather than free text: an unrecognised kind fails validation instead of reaching a dispatcher that would decide what to do with it at run time.

endpointRef.description: Names an external reference holding the endpoint. Endpoints are referenced rather than inlined because a literal endpoint in a committed file is a customer environment identifier (NFR-02).

authentication.description: How the connection authenticates. No property here carries material: the method names a mechanism and credentialRef names where a value lives.

method.description: Both are federated and hold no material in configuration. Methods that require a stored credential are absent from this enumeration rather than discouraged, so the contract cannot express one.

credentialRef.description: Optional, and an indirection only. Names an entry in externalReferences; it never carries the value. Present so a consumer whose identity is provisioned elsewhere can point at it.

mode.description: Fixed in v1. A single-member enumeration states the constraint twice on purpose: a mutating mode is both absent from the contract and pinned, so widening it is a deliberate schema change rather than a configuration choice.

networkAccess.description: Declared rather than inferred, so a connector reaching a public endpoint is visible in review instead of discovered at run time.

timeoutSeconds.description: Bounded above as well as below. An unbounded timeout would let one connector consume the execution's whole wall-clock budget and starve the rest.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29). Pinned with const rather than left to the pattern: without it an instance could declare any version at all and still validate, which made the declaration decorative (NFR-21).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Constrained so an identifier cannot carry arbitrary text, and English by construction (FR-03, CON-01).

externalReferenceName.description: Names an entry in the framework configuration's externalReferences. The pattern is deliberately narrow: it cannot express a URL, a connection string or a bearer token, so a value pasted here fails validation rather than being committed.
